changes.addition:
\paragraph*{Individual contribution.}
My supervisor, Dr Mengxuan Zhang, proposed the direction of bringing JHQ
to GPUs and provided guidance through regular discussions. I undertook
the GPU system development, including index construction and layout,
query execution optimisations, and refinement-budget calibration. I also
carried out the experimental design, baseline comparisons and analysis,
and decided which approaches and conclusions to retain. AI tools
provided substantial assistance with code development, experiment
automation, analysis, review and thesis drafting, as detailed in the
\hyperref[front:provenance]{research and AI assistance statement}.

changes.addition:
\paragraph*{个人贡献。}
导师 Mengxuan Zhang 博士提出了将 JHQ 移植到 GPU 的研究方向，并通过定期讨论提供指导。我承担 GPU 系统开发，包括索引构建与布局、查询执行优化和精排预算校准；同时完成实验设计、基线比较与结果分析，并决定采用哪些方案和结论。AI 工具在代码开发、实验自动化、分析、审核和论文起草中提供了实质性辅助，具体见\hyperref[front:provenance]{研究与 AI 辅助说明}。
